title: Turning mango kernel waste into high-energy porous carbon: a sustainable electrode material for high-performance supercapacitors with exceptional stability
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14183-14193
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02129D, Paper

This study explores the sustainable production of high-performance supercapacitor electrodes from waste mango kernels, addressing the growing need for eco-friendly energy storage solutions.
